description: Dark muted teal woven court gown with a low square neckline and fitted opaque bodice, elbow-length sleeves, broad brown geometric woven sash with round metal clasp, gold and muted red patterned borders down the center and around the hem, floor-length skirt with a modest front underlayer opening, and a taupe fringed shoulder wrap resting along both arms. Brown leather shoes, round shoulder brooches and small hanging earrings. Both hands rest together at the waist; full hair and shoes remain inside the canvas. No headgear, armor or weapon. The garment follows the full court-coverage modifier but is more richly ornamented than minimal landowner edging.
